title: Iraqi conflict
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Iraqi conflict", at revision 1377860410, opens: "The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q47015896, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "armed conflict in Iraq". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
